signature.name: VTask.cons
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> [DecidableEq α] -> {δ : α → Sort u_2} -> (m : Multiset α) -> (a : α) -> (b : δ a) -> (f : (a : α) → a ∈ m → δ a) -> (a' : α) -> a' ∈ a ::ₘ m → δ a'

conventions.point: priority of b over f at a
conventions.statement: When a' = a, VTask.cons m a b f returns b, regardless of whether a also belongs to m and regardless of what f would return for a.
conventions.note: This is a deliberate design choice: the freshly supplied value takes precedence.

facts.statement: example : VTask.cons ({1} : Multiset ℕ) 0 (99 : ℕ) (fun a _ => a) 0 (Multiset.mem_cons_self 0 {1}) = 99 := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.violated_property: for a' ≠ a the result must equal f a', not b

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {δ : α → Sort*} (m : Multiset α) (a : α) (b : δ a) (f : ∀ a ∈ m, δ a) (h : a ∈ a ::ₘ m), VTask.cons m a b f a h = b

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {δ : α → Sort*} {m : Multiset α} {a a' : α} {b : δ a} {f : ∀ a ∈ m, δ a} (h' : a' ∈ a ::ₘ m) (h : a' ≠ a), VTask.cons m a b f a' h' = f a' ((Multiset.mem_cons.1 h').resolve_left h)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {δ : α → Sort*} {m : Multiset α} {a : α} (g : ∀ a' ∈ a ::ₘ m, δ a'), VTask.cons m a (g a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a m)) (fun a' ha' => g a' (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem ha')) = g

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] {δ : α → Sort*} {m : Multiset α} {a : α} {r : ∀ ⦃a⦄, δ a → δ a → Prop} {b₁ b₂ : δ a} {f₁ f₂ : ∀ a' ∈ m, δ a'}, r b₁ b₂ → (∀ (x : α) (hx : x ∈ m), r (f₁ x hx) (f₂ x hx)) → ∀ (x : α) (hx : x ∈ a ::ₘ m), r (VTask.cons m a b₁ f₁ x hx) (VTask.cons m a b₂ f₂ x hx)
